# AI entrypoints

Primary context: AI_CONTEXT.md
Evidence rules: AGENTS.md
Public project status: 03_portfolio/evidence-index.md
Sanitized company work evidence: evidence/company-github/README.md
Verified career claims: evidence/company-github/career-claims.csv
Project narratives: evidence/company-github/projects.md
Monthly snapshots: evidence/company-github/monthly/

Do not infer private repository names, customers, source code, production scale, or
deployment status beyond the sanitized claims. Commit authorship is not proof of
the identity that pushed an event to GitHub.
